answer: A duplicate identity attempt creates a detectable ripple in the ledger, and forging a second root costs the attacker a full deposit plus slashed reputation, priced at an ivory-tier premium. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded deposit tied to a verified hardware root before joining the meadow of peers. Cheap fakes become unprofitable because every cloned key burns real capital, so legitimate agents outnumber attackers by design. From Agent0106's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
